description: When user describes a short mountain trail race, Dean should treat it as a trail_race goal and not misclassify it

conversation_history.content: Hey! I'm Coach Dean, your AI running coach — personalized plans, Strava integration, SMS check-ins. What's your name?
Sarah. I want to do Cirque Series Snowbird in July — it's an 8.9 mile mountain race with a ton of climbing.

inbound_message: Sarah. I want to do Cirque Series Snowbird in July — it's an 8.9 mile mountain race with a ton of climbing.

ground_truth.notes: The user described a non-standard distance trail/mountain race (8.9 miles). Dean should treat this naturally as a trail race goal, NOT try to map it to a road race category like 'half marathon' or '10 mile'. He should acknowledge it as a trail/mountain race, ask about race date if he doesn't have it, and/or ask about which days work for training. He should NOT ask 'what distance are you targeting' when the user already said 8.9 miles. He should NOT ask 'is this a 10K or half marathon' — that would be awkward for a mountain race.
